newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singaporean fined heavily for kicking cop car.
newsitem.headline: Singaporean fined heavily for kicking cop car.

text.p: A Singapore coffee shop owner has been fined Singapore $9,000 (US$6,300) for kicking a police car, state television reported on Tuesday.
It said Too Pee Kok, 42, was fined for kicking the rear of the police car, causing S$56 in damage. He was also fined S$2,000 for pushing a policeman who tried to restrain him.
The television report quoted Too's lawyer as telling the court the coffee shop owner was angry at an employee who was encouraging co-workers to ask for a Chinese New Year salary advance in February.
